name: Tissue Permeability
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: Which cells one cell type seals off from the rest of the tissue.

params.name: field
params.label: Grouping column
params.help:
Selects the annotation used to define the barrier and source populations.
Defaults to the dataset’s cell-type column.

params.name: barrier
params.label: Barrier cell type
params.help: Selects the population treated as an impassable barrier.

params.name: source
params.label: Route towards
params.help:
Selects the routing destination: the exposed tissue surface or another cell population.
Surface cells are identified along the section boundary and beside sufficiently large gaps.

params.name: source_type
params.label: Source cell type
params.help:
Selects the destination population when routing towards another cell type.
It must differ from the barrier population.

params.name: barrier_width
params.label: Barrier half-width
params.help:
Sets how closely a path may approach a barrier-cell centre, measured in median cell spacings.
Larger values treat the barrier as thicker.

params.name: max_gap
params.label: Largest gap a path may cross
params.help: Drop Delaunay edges longer than this many median cell spacings, so no route crosses a lumen or tissue gap.

params.name: paint
params.label: Map shows

options.label: Extra path forced by the barrier

params.help:
Selects whether the map displays sealed-compartment size, additional path length or detour factor.
This does not change the calculation.

params.name: n_null
params.label: Random barriers
params.help: Sets how many equally large random barriers are used for the grey plot band and the random-barrier comparison.
